title: Data visualization overview

location.series: Jessie W. Lee / Verizon Master Brand Redesign

slide_intent: Choose a visual form that makes a relationship understandable before adding decorative treatment.
strategic_value: A restrained palette and clear hierarchy can make Verizon’s numerical stories easier to follow.
demonstration: The July 22, 2021 overview moves from chart, bar and line examples to a multi-chart growth infographic and links for style and composition.
practical_value: Select a single chart for a relationship or combine several charts when a broader story needs multiple measures.

content_islands.name: Definition
content_islands.spec: Set the overview title in black above the introductory definition and two-column explanation.

content_islands.name: Basic chart types
content_islands.spec: Align a ring, bars and lines across three equal panels.

content_islands.name: Infographic example
content_islands.spec: Combine a prominent total, stepped bars, a percentage ring and line chart in one broad panel.

content_islands.name: Further guidance
content_islands.spec: Pair style-and-usage and composition examples at the bottom.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source states that visualization should communicate information quickly, clearly and simply.
reference_purposes.Application: It compares individual charts with an infographic that combines multiple visual elements and key points.
reference_purposes.Expression: Red, black and gray connect the different chart types.

ingredient.name: Chart emphasis color
ingredient.role: Direct attention to a selected series or value.
ingredient.application: Use the red highlight against black and gray comparison data as demonstrated in the chart specimens.
ingredient.scope: Observed July 2021 examples; chart figures are illustrative source content and are not independently verified business results.
